title: A team move, a contractor who has gone, and access that only ever grows

form.title: Access review — two changes, one removal each
form.intro: The access review asks one question of every change: what did this person lose? A ticket that only lists what was granted gets sent back.

fields.label: The changes this review asks for
What access you granted, and to whom
What access you removed, and why it was safe to remove
fields.hint: Least privilege is a removal. Name the group and say why the role no longer needs it.

fields.label: What you did about the contractor's account
fields.hint: A contractor past their end date is disabled, not locked — locked implies someone may unlock it again.

briefing:
The monthly access review on sso-01 has two items and one obvious question:

  1. Marco Silva has moved from the warehouse team to Finance. He needs finance. He
     must keep finance-reporting, which the finance systems team also uses.

  2. Chi Nguyen was a contractor whose agreement ended on 2026-08-31. The account is
     still active and still in the warehouse group.

The directory service is at lib/idp.py with state in /var/lib/ontrak-idp/directory.json
(HTTP on http://localhost:8081 if the service is running).

Make the two changes, each with a recorded reason. The review will be read by someone
checking that access is not simply accumulating — so whatever the change is, say what
was taken away.

objectives.text: Marco Silva is a member of finance
Marco Silva is no longer a member of warehouse
objectives.hint: This is the half of a team move people skip: `remove-member marco.silva warehouse`.

objectives.text: Marco Silva is still a member of finance-reporting
objectives.hint: Removing the old access must not remove the access he still needs. Check with `show-user` after both changes.

objectives.text: The contractor's account is disabled, not merely locked
objectives.hint: There is a difference in the directory between locked (a hold) and disabled (out of service).

hints: `lib/idp.py list-users` shows status, failed attempts and memberships at a glance.
Adding the new group and removing the old one are two commands; neither implies the other.
The contractor's status should read disabled. `--reason` records why, which is what the review wants to see.
`lib/idp.py audit` lists the changes with their reasons — read it before you call the ticket done.
reset_notes:
Reset re-clones the clean snapshot: Marco is back in warehouse only, and the
contractor's account is active again.

es.title: Un traslado de equipo, una persona contratada que se marchó y un acceso que solo crece
es.briefing:
La revisión mensual de accesos en sso-01 tiene dos puntos y una pregunta evidente:

  1. Marco Silva pasó del equipo de almacén a Finanzas. Necesita finance y debe conservar
     finance-reporting, que también usa el equipo de sistemas financieros.

  2. Chi Nguyen era una persona contratada cuyo acuerdo terminó el 2026-08-31. La cuenta
     sigue activa y sigue en el grupo warehouse.

El servicio de directorio está en lib/idp.py con su estado en
/var/lib/ontrak-idp/directory.json (HTTP en http://localhost:8081 si el servicio está en
ejecución).

Haz los dos cambios, cada uno con un motivo registrado. La revisión la leerá alguien que
comprueba que el acceso no se limita a acumularse, así que diga lo que se retiró.

objectives.added-to-new-group: Marco Silva pertenece al grupo finance
objectives.removed-from-old-group: Marco Silva ya no pertenece al grupo warehouse
objectives.kept-required-group: Marco Silva sigue perteneciendo a finance-reporting
objectives.contractor-disabled: La cuenta de la persona contratada está deshabilitada, no solo bloqueada

hints: `lib/idp.py list-users` muestra el estado, los intentos fallidos y las pertenencias de un vistazo.
Añadir el grupo nuevo y quitar el antiguo son dos comandos; ninguno implica al otro.
El estado de la persona contratada debe leerse disabled. `--reason` registra el motivo, que es lo que la revisión quiere ver.
`lib/idp.py audit` lista los cambios con sus motivos: léelo antes de dar el ticket por terminado.
